# PharmaAdda

> > PharmaAdda is India's comprehensive pharmaceutical business directory connecting manufacturers, distributors, PCD franchise opportunities, and third-party manufacturing services across medicines, cosmetics, and medical devices.

The platform serves as a B2B marketplace for the Indian pharmaceutical industry, covering GMP-certified manufacturers, AYUSH-approved ayurvedic products, regional franchise opportunities across states like Telangana, Gujarat, and Maharashtra, and specialized segments including critical care, analgesics, ophthalmic products, and cosmetic manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- PCD Franchise Opportunities
- Third-Party Manufacturing
- Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India
- Contract Manufacturing
- AYUSH & Ayurvedic Products
- Cosmetic & Skincare Manufacturing
- Medicine Wholesalers & Distributors
- Critical Care Products
- Ophthalmic Products
- Medical Devices & Equipment
- Pharmaceutical Export
- Regional Pharma Companies (Telangana, Gujarat, Maharashtra)
- Dosha Theory (Vata, Pitta, Kapha)
- Medical Representative Roles
